parameterMapping.decision: Retain default sheet gauge for fins; clappers deliberately thickened to 2.0–2.6 mm.
Reconstruct two shoulder-seated tongues per fin, with receiving long direction 4.5+fit.

parameterMapping.generator: receiving thickness=sheet+fit; fit .10–.30 mm TOTAL, default .15
parameterMapping.decision: Measured ~.10 mm direction informs calibration; .15 mm is proposed, not measured or universal.
Thicken to 2–3 layers at .20 mm, keep outside tongue and cord interfaces.

originalDesign.interaction: Hand-guided face-to-face plate taps; two independent external soft-cord loops form a flexible rear hinge. Opposed fin grips keep hands off contact faces. No spring return.
originalDesign.externalSupplies: two soft .8–1.2 mm cord loops and filament-compatible adhesive
originalDesign.assembly: Seat each two-tongued fin from outside its plate, bond fixed seats, put contact faces together, tie paired rear eyes with knots outside contact faces. Adjust loop slack manually.
originalDesign.preview: 0–35 degree representative rear-edge rotation, not exact flexible-cord kinematics. Export stays bed-flat.
originalDesign.personalization: Exact bounded sampled-image or accepted STL mesh Boolean engraving in protected lower-plate patch; depth .4–.6 mm and >=1.4 mm backing.

differsFromPrior: New opposed clapper contact mechanism and soft-cord hinge; not a rail race, optical kit, chime, drum or keycap. Original plate/fin/eye solids, four joint fits, contact assembly and motion-range checks. Shared generic studio/import/mesh-check infrastructure adapted from 20261031-21, not its mechanism.
sourceDefects: 27 edge-adjacent components, nonwatertight. Used as design reference only; original CSG reconstruction, no automatic repair.
